fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Exterior white paint looks clean overall; some dullness and light road film visible along the lower doors and rocker panels
Black lower front bumper trim and grille surround look slightly faded/grey in the front three-quarter shot
Dust and light lint on the driver and passenger floor mats
Light dust on the dashboard and center console trim
Leather seats look worn-in with some creasing and dullness on the front seat bolsters
Aftermarket steering wheel cover and a child seat in the cabin make the interior look lived-in
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Q7 and it looks like a nice, well-kept SUV. A few spots in the photos could pop more, like dust on the floor mats and dash and some slightly faded black trim on the front bumper. We do mobile pre-sale details that come to you, including leather cleaning and conditioning and trim restoration. Would you like a quote?
